How it works

Getting into a GameOn community or event takes three steps.

1

Pick your sport

Basketball, Pickleball, Badminton, Volleyball — or ask about one that isn't listed yet.

2

Message us on WhatsApp

Call or WhatsApp +971 55 366 8647 for details on sports facilities & auditorium venues, corporate events and organizing your own event. Consult with us and we'll help you plan exactly what you need.

3

Show up and play

We handle the venue, the format and the schedule — you handle showing up.
